summary: Phase 3 (/contacto OSM + consent-gated Google Maps + Cómo llegar CMS) tested end-to-end on the preview URL with Playwright, plus Vitest (62/62) and backend regression pytest (17/17). All journeys JRN-41 to JRN-50 passed, as did the edge case, the cookie policy mention and the regressions. No functional bugs found. Only minor a11y/design notes.

results.JRN-41: PASS - after reject: contact-map-osm data-lat=40.4241269 data-lng=-3.6976262, aria-label 'Mapa de ubicación de ESPACIO Q', 1 marker, attribution '© OpenStreetMap', 18 tiles loaded; 0 requests to google.com/gstatic.com/googleapis.com across first load + 3 reloads (also 0 before any banner choice, and 0 on home).
results.JRN-42: PASS - view-google-btn -> consent notice (0 Google requests so far) -> accept -> iframe contact-map-google, data-map-provider=google, no reload (window marker kept); cookie-opt-maps checked, analytics/marketing unchecked.
results.JRN-43: PASS - reload shows Google embed directly.
results.JRN-44: PASS - uncheck cookie-opt-maps + save -> OSM again without reload, iframe removed; 0 new Google requests over 4 s + reload; cookie g:0.
results.JRN-45: PASS - banner Aceptar and modal Aceptar todas both set maps=true and show the Google embed; cookie-opt-maps is off by default.
results.Edge inline-before-banner: PASS - banner stays visible (also after reload), localStorage {analytics:false, marketing:false, maps:true, partial:true}. Note: clicking banner 'Rechazar' afterwards also sets maps=false (reject all), which is consistent.
results.JRN-46: PASS - contact-directions-btn is <a> href=https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=ESPACIO%20Q%2C%20Calle%20de%20Pelayo%2041%2C%2028004%20Madrid target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, opens a new tab; contact-map-open-google-link points to the /maps/place/Espacio+Q URL.
results.JRN-47: PASS - metro text matches, parking text present, contact-directions-bus absent.
results.JRN-48: PASS - owner login, block listed, 'Cómo llegar (bajo el mapa…)' group with #f-directions-metro/bus/parking; draft not public (but visible with ?preview=1); publish -> public shows edited Metro + Autobús, revision count 0->1, v2. Restored the defaults and published as v3; DB published == draft, hasUnpublished=false, bus=''.
results.JRN-49: PASS - 375 px and 1440 px: scrollWidth == innerWidth (also in Google mode at 375); tiles 256x256 loaded, nothing grey or stretched; Tab order reaches the Leaflet container (focusable), marker, zoom controls, Cómo llegar, Abrir en Google Maps, Ver en Google Maps.
results.JRN-50: PASS - with tile.openstreetmap.org aborted, the contact-map-error overlay appears; address and Cómo llegar stay visible and open the directions in a new tab.
results.Cookies page: PASS - section 2 includes '3. Mapas de terceros (Google Maps) (Desactivada por defecto)' text.
results.Regression: PASS - contact form with test_phase3@example.com -> 200 {ok:true} + success state; banner reject on / and accept on /servicios work; Vitest 62/62; backend tests/test_espacioq_api.py 17/17.

issues: 'Abrir en Google Maps' now appears twice (aside 'Ubicación' card and below the map), so screen readers hear two identical link texts. Consider keeping just one.
Cómo llegar grid is md:grid-cols-3 but only 2 items show by default (Bus empty), which leaves an empty third column at desktop. Consider adapting the column count to the number of items.
The section's aria-labelledby='como-llegar-title' points to a heading that is not rendered when all directions are empty (dangling reference).

action_items: Optional: remove the duplicate 'Abrir en Google Maps' link or give the two links distinct accessible names
Optional: adapt the directions grid columns to the item count; fix the dangling aria-labelledby when the directions block is hidden
critical_code_review_comments: contact-map.tsx: the Leaflet popup HTML is built with string interpolation of name/address from salon settings (bindPopup(`${name}...`)). This is owner-controlled data, so the risk is low, but escaping it or using a DOM node would be safer.
cms-editor.tsx has no data-testid attributes (667 lines, close to the 700-line limit). Tests relied on ids such as #f-directions-metro.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ contact submission (test_phase3@example.com, simulated, no real email). The CMS page_contacto went from v1 to v2 (TEST_ edits) to v3 (defaults restored). Directions are back at their defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Black Friday promo popup intercepts clicks: use add_init_script to set sessionStorage/localStorage 'espacioq_bf25_popup_dismissed_v1'='1'. Consent key espacioq_cookie_consent. CMS field ids follow f-<path>, e.g. #f-directions-metro. Login uses #login-email and input[name=password]. page_contacto is now at v3.
